description: Bandwidth / traffic graph data for a dedicated server. Use it to answer questions about usage, saturation or packet errors over a day, week or month. Read-only.

scale.description: Time window: day, week or month (default month).

type.description: Metric: port_bits (default, throughput), port_upkts, port_percent, port_errors, port_pktsize, port_discards.

name: impreza_dedicated_bandwidth
